parts:
I realized nobody looked at this:

https://github.com/stan-dev/example-models/pull/20

It's a bunch of models that were sitting in branches on
stan-dev/stan that I moved over to example-models.

I can just go ahead and merge it without any review if
people don't think we should bother reviewing example models.

We really need to clean all this up, but somebody was
just asking on the users list for the CJS models, so I
thought they should be available.

- Bob
